highlights: Terminal panes now show their active branch and provide per-pane branch controls while preserving sibling terminal ownership
Terminal dictated-text paste is available through the terminal action surface
fixes: Local development runs use a private Tauri runtime identity so they can coexist with the installed Stable application
Saved-project loading is no longer blocked by a full SQLite integrity scan, and the initial window paints a startup state before frontend modules load
databaseChanges: No database schema changes; schema version remains 46
requiredManualActions: Use the in-app Stable update button and approve the safe restart; no manual installer download is required
